logo.$description: Logo's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--logo-<name>) on the page, a container or one Logo, and every Logo inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

height-sm.$description: Its height at size sm (24px): a compact bar or a footer.

height-md.$description: Its height at size md (32px), the default: a Navbar or Sidebar.

height-lg.$description: Its height at size lg (40px): a sign-in page or a splash.
